description.text:
One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game LEGEND series on 9 October 2009, made for the Nintendo DS games Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver. It came out the same day as SoulSilver Collection, and each has Pokémon found only in it. Its headline is Ho-Oh LEGEND, a legendary Pokémon made of two cards, drawn by the filmmaker Shinji Higuchi, who later directed Shin Godzilla. The series also brought Great Pokémon, stronger than ordinary Pokémon and called Pokémon Prime in English; here they are Feraligatr, Ampharos, Donphan and Blissey. The cards are numbered to 70. In English the two Collections were merged into HeartGold & SoulSilver, released on 10 February 2010.

LEGEND changed both packs and rules. Each pack held two holo cards, one of them a mirror holo of a card that would normally be plain. Trainer cards were renamed Goods, Weakness became ×2 throughout, and basic Energy got new art with a silhouette of a Pokémon of its type. A hidden Goods card, Alph Lithograph, written in Unown letters and mentioned neither on the pack nor on the official site, is numbered past the end of the set.
